kpis.description: Product category actual book vs target book — sum of actual_book / sum of target_book across products in category

kpis.name: Product Revenue Achievement
kpis.description: Product category actual revenue vs target revenue — same aggregation as book

kpis.name: Product NPL Rate
kpis.description: Product category weighted-avg NPL rate — book-weighted across products in category. CBK PG/04 aligned.

kpis.name: Product Growth Rate
kpis.description: Product category book growth quarter-over-quarter — book-weighted avg

kpis.name: Liquidity Coverage Ratio
kpis.description: BCBS d295 LCR — HQLA / 30-day net cash outflows. Regulatory minimum 100%. Treasury-owned.

kpis.name: Net Stable Funding Ratio
kpis.description: BCBS d295 NSFR — Available stable funding / required stable funding. Regulatory minimum 100%.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.description: Net interest income / average earning assets. Core Treasury profitability driver.

kpis.name: FX Trading Income
kpis.description: Foreign exchange trading revenue — dealer P&L plus corporate FX spread. Treasury-owned.

kpis.name: Trade Finance Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue from trade finance instruments (LC, guarantees, collections, supplier finance). Replaces K022.

kpis.name: Trade Document Check TAT
kpis.description: Average hours from document receipt to discrepancy decision. ICC UCP 600 §14 mandates within 5 banking days; operational target far tighter.

kpis.name: Letters of Credit — Volume
kpis.description: Number of LCs issued in the period. Volume proxy for trade finance market share.

kpis.name: Campaign ROI
kpis.description: Marketing-attributable revenue / campaign spend, expressed as %. Marketing-owned.

kpis.name: Brand Awareness
kpis.description: Unaided brand recall in target segment, survey-based.

kpis.name: Marketing-Qualified Leads
kpis.description: Leads passed to sales pipeline meeting MQL criteria. Feeds pipeline_to_bsc downstream.

kpis.name: Marketing-Driven Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue attributable to marketing-sourced leads (UTM + first-touch attribution).

kpis.name: Account Opening TAT
kpis.description: Median hours from KYC submission to account live. CSO-owned operational quality metric.

kpis.name: Complaint Resolution Rate
kpis.description: % of customer complaints resolved within SLA. Replaces K008.

kpis.name: Pipeline Deals Won
kpis.description: Count of pipeline deals reaching won stages (Disbursed / Closed Won / Signed / Documentation) per quarter. Sourced from pipeline_activity_bridge.

kpis.name: Pipeline Conversion Rate
kpis.description: Won / (won + lost + active) × 100. Sales effectiveness. Replaces K020.

kpis.name: New Customers Acquired
kpis.description: Distinct customers from won pipeline deals per quarter. Sourced from pipeline_activity_bridge OR estimated by branch_staff_generator for staff not active in pipeline.

kpis.name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
kpis.description: Cost-to-Income Ratio = Total Operating Costs / Total Operating Income × 100. Tier-1 benchmark; lower is better. Tracks whether income growth outpaces cost growth. Computed by utils/financial_ratios_engine.py (v10.390). Awaiting MD target.

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.description: Return on Equity = Net Income / Average Shareholders' Equity × 100. NOTE: v10.390 engine uses PBT (not net income) since mgmt_accounts has no tax field. Engine reports the caveat in result.note. Awaiting tax field addition + MD target.
kpis._caveat: Engine uses PBT until tax field added to mgmt_accounts

kpis.name: Total Deposit Growth
kpis.description: Total Deposit Growth = (Deposits EoP - Deposits BoP) / Deposits BoP × 100. Bank-wide deposit growth aggregating Retail+Commercial. Computed by utils/financial_ratios_engine.py (v10.390). Awaiting MD target.
